record.paper_title: Gradings, Braidings, Representations, Paraparticles: Some Open Problems
record.original_question: For each grading of P_BF or P_FB by a small finite abelian group G, classify all compatible braided group structures. This means determining the possible bicharacters, equivalently commutation factors or color functions, the corresponding universal R-matrices of the group Hopf algebra C G, and the corresponding braidings of the C G-module or C G-comodule categories, and then deciding which choices admit compatible graded algebra and coalgebra structures that make the paraparticle algebra into a braided group.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $P_{BF}$ and $P_{FB}$ denote the relative parabose–parafermi paraparticle algebras: associative unital $\mathbb{C}$-algebras generated by parabosonic creation/annihilation generators $\{b_i^+, b_i^-\}_{i=1,\dots,m}$ and parafermionic creation/annihilation generators $\{f_j^+, f_j^-\}_{j=1,\dots,n}$, subject to the trilinear relations of Greenberg–Messiah type, with mixed relations of either the "BF" or "FB" type (i.e. the two inequivalent conventions for the parabose–parafermi mixed trilinear relations).

Let $G$ be a small finite abelian group, and consider a grading $P = \bigoplus_{g\in G} P_g$ of $P \in \{P_{BF}, P_{FB}\}$ by $G$ (so each generator is assigned a homogeneous degree in $G$, and the relations are homogeneous).

Recall that a skew-symmetric bicharacter on $G$ is a map $\beta: G\times G \to \mathbb{C}^*$ which is a character in each argument and satisfies $\beta(g,h)\beta(h,g)=1$. Equivalently, such a $\beta$ corresponds to a triangular universal $R$-matrix $R_\beta \in \mathbb{C}G \otimes \mathbb{C}G$ for the group Hopf algebra $\mathbb{C}G$, and to a braiding $\Psi_{V,W}(v\otimes w) = \beta(|v|,|w|)\, w\otimes v$ on the symmetric monoidal category of $G$-graded vector spaces ($\mathbb{C}G$-modules/comodules).

The problem: For each grading of $P_{BF}$ and of $P_{FB}$ by each small finite abelian group $G$:

(a) Classify all compatible braided group structures, i.e. determine all skew-symmetric bicharacters $\beta: G\times G\to\mathbb{C}^*$ (equivalently, all commutation factors / color functions, all triangular universal $R$-matrices of $\mathbb{C}G$, and all corresponding braidings of the categories of $\mathbb{C}G$-modules/comodules) that are compatible with the given grading on $P$.

(b) For each such bicharacter, decide whether there exists a graded algebra and graded coalgebra structure on $P$ (with counit and braided antipode) making $(P,\beta)$ into a braided group (Hopf algebra) in the braided category determined by $\beta$.
artifact.status_search_result: The question is posed as a research objective on classifying bicharacters/R-matrices and compatible braided group structures on paraparticle algebras. Searches reveal related work (Kanakoglou, Daskaloyannis, Majid on anyonic/braided Lie algebras and on super-Hopf/braided extensions of paraparticle algebras), but no source provides a complete classification for all gradings of $P_{BF}$ and $P_{FB}$ by all small finite abelian groups. The problem appears to remain open.
